tools.name: enrich_investigation_entities
tools.description: Enrich investigation entities with GeoLite2 MMDB context, inferred attacker/victim roles, country relationships, and recent-news/threat-intel query leads.
tools.when_to_use: Use before writing the incident story, attacker motive hypothesis, or country relationship analysis.

tools.name: search_security_context
tools.description: Search Blackgate alerts, incidents, campaigns, MITRE knowledge, and agent memory for context relevant to a SOC investigation.
tools.when_to_use: Use first when the analyst asks a broad question or when the agent needs historical memory.

tools.name: timeline_by_entity
tools.description: Build a chronological timeline for an IP, host, domain, user, or DNS query across local alerts and Elastic Security alerts.
tools.esql: FROM security-alerts, .alerts-security.alerts-* | WHERE source_ip == ?entity OR dest_ip == ?entity OR source.ip == ?entity OR destination.ip == ?entity OR query == ?entity OR dns.question.name == ?entity OR destination_domain == ?entity OR url.domain == ?entity | SORT @timestamp ASC | KEEP @timestamp, event.kind, event.category, event.action, source_ip, dest_ip, source.ip, destination.ip, query, dns.question.name, destination_domain, url.domain, alert, rule.name, kibana.alert.rule.name, threat.technique.id, threat.technique.name | LIMIT 100
tools.when_to_use: Use when explaining evidence or reconstructing attacker activity.

tools.name: cluster_incident_candidates
tools.description: Find likely incident clusters by grouping alerts by source entity, MITRE technique, alert name, and time bucket.
tools.esql: FROM security-alerts, .alerts-security.alerts-* | WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - ?lookback_hours HOURS | EVAL src = COALESCE(source.ip, source_ip), dst = COALESCE(destination.ip, dest_ip), technique = COALESCE(TO_STRING(threat.technique.id), TO_STRING(kibana.alert.rule.threat.technique.id)), signal = COALESCE(rule.name, kibana.alert.rule.name, alert) | STATS alert_count = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), destinations = VALUES(dst), signals = VALUES(signal), techniques = VALUES(technique) BY src | WHERE alert_count >= 2 | SORT alert_count DESC | LIMIT 50
tools.when_to_use: Use before writing or updating incidents.

tools.name: mitre_from_elastic_security
tools.description: Retrieve MITRE ATT&CK techniques and tactics directly from Elastic Security alert and rule metadata.
tools.esql: FROM .alerts-security.alerts-*, security-alerts | WHERE source.ip == ?entity OR destination.ip == ?entity OR source_ip == ?entity OR dest_ip == ?entity OR dns.question.name == ?entity OR query == ?entity | WHERE threat.technique.id IS NOT NULL OR kibana.alert.rule.threat.technique.id IS NOT NULL | KEEP @timestamp, rule.name, kibana.alert.rule.name, threat.tactic.name, threat.technique.id, threat.technique.name, kibana.alert.rule.threat.tactic.name, kibana.alert.rule.threat.technique.id, kibana.alert.rule.threat.technique.name | LIMIT 100
tools.when_to_use: Use before asking Gemini to infer ATT&CK techniques.

tools.name: campaign_memory_lookup
tools.description: Look up campaign memory by IP/domain overlap, MITRE technique overlap, or campaign name.
tools.esql: FROM blackgate.campaigns, blackgate.mitre_knowledge, blackgate.agent_memory | WHERE TO_STRING(entities.ips) LIKE CONCAT("*", ?query, "*") OR TO_STRING(entities.domains) LIKE CONCAT("*", ?query, "*") OR TO_STRING(technique.id) == ?query OR TO_STRING(campaign.name) LIKE CONCAT("*", ?query, "*") OR TO_STRING(memory.text) LIKE CONCAT("*", ?query, "*") | KEEP campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.confidence, campaign.description, technique.id, technique.name, tactic.name, memory.text, related_incident_ids, detection_notes | LIMIT 50
tools.when_to_use: Use when determining whether a new incident belongs to an existing campaign.

tools.name: save_blackgate_investigation
tools.description: Persist a final investigation report, campaign hypothesis, MITRE mapping, and remediation into Elasticsearch.
tools.when_to_use: Use after the agent has enough evidence to finalize an analyst-ready report.
